# FUSE on VIPER (generated by scripts/run_viper.py)

Items = mammography cases, verifiers = radiologists, gold = cancer status at 455-day follow-up.
AUC against cancer status. FUSE gets missing reads as 0 (each reader's column mapped to [-1, 1]).

## FFDM

Which radiologists read a case predicts cancer with cross-validated AUC **94.2**, using no scores at all. The full-matrix numbers below are therefore contaminated for any method that sees missing reads as values (FUSE here). The dense blocks have no missing reads.

### FFDM, full matrix (missingness leaks the label)

712 cases (115 cancers), 43 readers, 67% missing

| Method | AUC | Sens. | Spec. | AUC vs MV (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Majority vote (share recalling) | 72.9 | 76.5 | 55.3 |  |
| Mean suspicion score (per-reader z) | 73.2 |  |  | +0.3 [-1.5, +2.2] |
| Dawid-Skene (recall) | 74.4 | 72.2 | 58.8 | +1.5 [-1.0, +4.2] |
| FUSE logistic (recall) | 74.8 | 81.7 | 40.7 | +1.9 [-0.7, +4.6] |
| FUSE posterior (recall) | 70.3 | 81.7 | 42.7 | -2.6 [-6.4, +1.2] |
| FUSE logistic (suspicion score) | 74.8 | 9.6 | 99.8 | +1.9 [-1.1, +5.0] |
| FUSE posterior (suspicion score) | 80.9 | 15.7 | 99.5 | +8.0 [+4.1, +12.0] |
| Median single reader | 68.4 |  |  |  |
| Best single reader (picked with labels) | 77.9 |  |  |  |
